_comment: Pinned upstream sources for LeGO-LOAM (lego) and A-LOAM (aloam). Written 2026-10-12 by the lego/aloam environment agent. SHAs verified with git ls-remote and git log in env/src/<method>/.

dependency_required_by_readme.name: GTSAM
dependency_required_by_readme.readme_text: gtsam (Georgia Tech Smoothing and Mapping library, 4.0.0-alpha2); wget https://github.com/borglab/gtsam/archive/4.0.0-alpha2.zip; cmake ..; sudo make install
dependency_required_by_readme.notes: 4.0.0-alpha2 has no GTSAM_BUILD_WITH_MARCH_NATIVE option and adds no -march flags (checked in its CMakeLists.txt and cmake/).

lego.readme_build_command: catkin_make -j1 (first build; needed to generate cloud_msgs)
lego.local_clone_state: checked out on branch master at head_sha; patches 0001+0002 applied in the working tree, not committed (git diff HEAD reproduces them)

dependency_required_by_readme.name: Ceres Solver

version_pinned_elsewhere_in_repo.value: ENV CERES_VERSION="1.12.0" (with FROM ros:kinetic-perception and PCL 1.8.0 built from source)

1.12.0.why: pinned in the repository's own docker/Dockerfile

1.14.0.why: latest Ceres release when the pinned A-LOAM commit was made

dependency_required_by_readme.chosen_for_docker: 1.12.0 (Docker build arg CERES_TAG, commit CERES_COMMIT; see open questions in configs/aloam/source_audit.md)
dependency_required_by_readme.evidence: Probe on 2026-10-12 (host GCC 11.4, -std=c++11, Eigen 3.3.4 headers): Ceres 1.12.0 library target compiled with no errors, and A-LOAM's lidarFactor.hpp autodiff factors with EigenQuaternionParameterization and HuberLoss compiled, linked and evaluated. Not a Melodic build; GCC 7.5 not tested.

aloam.readme_ros_distros: Ubuntu 16.04 or 18.04; ROS Kinetic or Melodic
aloam.local_clone_state: checked out on branch devel at head_sha; patches 0001+0002 applied in the working tree, not committed (git diff HEAD reproduces them)
